title: 🔎 Change Log Blame View: View change history in a different way
summary: The Change Log Blame View extension reorganizes standard change log data into a matrix-style view where rows represent fields and columns represent events, making it easier to track when specific record values changed, by whom, and why.
key_points: Matrix layout displays change history with fields as rows and events as columns for easier timeline visualization
Filters and groups change log entries by table and primary key, excluding audit fields to reduce clutter
Reusable pattern via page extensions allows adding a 'Change Log (Blame View)' action to any record page
Helps quickly identify which field changed, when it changed, and which user made the change

quotes.text: This way, instead of reviewing isolated entries, you can read the history almost like a visual timeline.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core benefit of the matrix layout for understanding record evolution visually

quotes.text: This is not a closed solution. The idea can be reused on any page where you can identify the current record.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the extension's reusability across different pages and record types through a standardized pattern
